result.summary: Found several layout and content issues: overlapping text on a restaurant card, a truncated restaurant name, and a missing delivery time range that looks corrupted.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the delivery info text '25–30 delivery · Ramen' overlaps itself (garbled as '25-30delivery'), making the delivery time unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Fix the layout/stacking so delivery time and category sit on one clear line without overlapping characters; ensure proper spacing and z-order for badge vs. text.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' restaurant name is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis, so the full name is cut off.
issues.suggestion: Show a full or ellipsis-truncated name consistently, or allow the card title to wrap/scale so the restaurant name remains legible.

issues.description: Delivery line under Tokumaru Ramen Bar is missing units and separators (reads like '25-30delivery' instead of e.g. '25–30 min delivery · Ramen').
issues.suggestion: Restore the full formatted string with 'min', spacing, and the middle dot separator to match other cards.

issues.description: Category chips row and 'Fastest near you' cards intentionally peek off-screen, but the Healthy chip and third card title sit flush against the edge in a way that can look unfinished next to the broken text below.
issues.suggestion: Keep horizontal peek as a scroll affordance, but ensure titles use ellipsis and don’t collide with other layout bugs.
